criteria.description: Typed RunConfig loading, canonical hashing, explicit staged pipeline construction, capability preflight, and dry-run/model-summary are available.
criteria.evidence: tests/phase_12/test_config_backend.py passes; CPU dry-run reports allocated=false; the tiny pipeline constructs registry, dataset, model, PEFT, optimizer, task, evaluator, trainer, and checkpoint stages.

criteria.description: CPU, CUDA, and lazy XLA-TPU AcceleratorBackend implementations keep device-specific APIs behind the backend boundary.
criteria.evidence: CPU and CUDA one-step runs pass; backend imports remain lazy for torch_xla; backend-neutrality checks and backend capability gates are present; XLA model preparation re-ties weights after placement.

criteria.description: Task-specific forward-and-loss semantics are exposed through a shared TrainingStep interface for classification, segmentation, 2D VLM, and 3D VLM families.
criteria.evidence: medfm/training/steps.py provides the shared protocol and family adapters; CPU and CUDA tiny 2D/3D VLM smokes pass through VLMTrainingStep and ThreeDVLMTrainingStep, alongside classification and segmentation smokes.

criteria.description: Precision, attention, accumulation, clipping, FP32 sensitive scalar handling, NF4 policy, cache policy, and backend compatibility are explicit.
criteria.evidence: RunConfig validation and backend autocast/scaler paths are implemented; optimizer clipping and loss-output FP32 promotion are covered by the Phase 12 suite; cache disabling and gradient-checkpointing are applied at the backend model boundary.

criteria.description: Deterministic distributed sampling, bounded static-shape buckets, warmup, XLA loader boundaries, and padded-sample masking are implemented.
criteria.evidence: medfm/training/data.py and distributed.py provide resumable sampler state, epoch set_epoch propagation, bounded bucket plans, repeated-bucket warmup, process-group initialization, backend dataloader wrapping, pinned/nonblocking batch transfer, and sample masks.

criteria.description: Optimizer groups, quantized-base rejection, freeze boundary transitions, scheduler preservation, and gradient audits are explicit.
criteria.evidence: Phase 12 tests pass accumulation, freeze-boundary, and optimizer behavior; construction rejects duplicate, frozen, or quantized trainable parameters.

criteria.description: Memory planning reserves headroom, estimates resource classes, emits ordered OOM guidance, and never mutates scientific configuration automatically.
criteria.evidence: OOM suggestion ordering and configuration immutability pass; CPU and CUDA results include memory plans and CUDA peak allocated/reserved measurements.

criteria.description: Atomic resumable checkpoints include model, component, optimizer, scheduler/scaler, RNG, sampler, topology, hashes, metrics, and best-criterion state; adapter-only exports are separate.
criteria.evidence: Checkpoint corruption is rejected, completed-checkpoint resume is a no-op, CPU safetensors adapter export tests pass, and a fresh single-rank torch.distributed.checkpoint save/restore smoke verifies model and AdamW state.

criteria.description: Local tracking, provenance capture, redaction, pre-collective non-finite checks, failure reports, interruption checkpoints, and evaluator reductions are implemented.
criteria.evidence: Training results and run artifacts contain source/runtime/topology/memory metadata; tracking and failure-report paths are implemented under medfm/training; finite-loss guards run before collectives.

criteria.description: CPU contract and acceptance validation pass for the Phase 12 implementation.
criteria.evidence: python -m pytest tests/phase_12 -q reports 12 passed; python -m medfm.tools.validate_phase --phase 12 passes.

criteria.description: Tiny CUDA baseline optimizer steps and CPU/CUDA one-step parity are verified on available hardware.
criteria.evidence: CUDA classification, 2D segmentation, 3D segmentation, and 2D/3D VLM each complete one optimizer step; accelerator parity reports absolute loss delta 0.0 at atol 1e-3.

criteria.description: TPU PJRT optimizer steps, stable compilation, replicated reduction, SPMD/FSDP checkpointing, and portable TPU export are verified.
criteria.justification: torch_xla is not installed on this workstation; no TPU result is fabricated. The XLA backend, loader, metrics, compilation gate, and policy paths remain explicit and fail closed.

criteria.description: CUDA DDP/FSDP and multi-rank topology-change checkpoint/resume acceptance are verified.
criteria.justification: Only one CUDA device was available for this run. Distributed launch and wrapping helpers are implemented, and the single-rank DCP branch is smoke-tested, but no multi-device result is claimed.

criteria.description: Phase 12 recipe schema, memory profiles, checkpoint compatibility rules, and protected accelerator command guidance are handed off.
criteria.evidence: next_phase_handoff.md records schema extension points, known-safe smoke settings, compatibility rules, DCP/SPMD checkpoint rules, and constrained GPU/TPU launch, profile, parity, and checkpoint commands.
